name: charly-plugins
description: Claude Code, Codex, and Kimi plugins for OpenCharly — The wonky DevOps tool for you and your agents: runtime commands, schema authoring, contributor internals, and deployable image families.

plugins.name: charly-agent
plugins.description: The `charly tui` terminal UI for the agent control plane (candy/plugin-agent).

plugins.name: charly-agentteams
plugins.description: Self-contained skills for the AgentTeams multi-agent stack (CachyOS base): the decomposed agentteams box — minio, matrix/tuwunel, element, higress, controller — on pod and vm substrates, plus the compiled-in `charly agentteams` management CLI.

plugins.name: charly-authoring
plugins.description: The `charly box add-candy/cat/fetch/labels/refresh/rm-candy/set/write` authoring verbs served by candy/plugin-authoring.

plugins.name: charly-automation
plugins.description: Automation/customization knobs — tmux verb, host-side wrappers (alias, udev), topic flags (encryption, sidecars, openclaw deployment).

plugins.name: charly-bpf
plugins.description: The `charly bpf` eBPF program surface served by candy/plugin-bpf.

plugins.name: charly-build
plugins.description: Build/authoring CLI verbs — build, generate, list, inspect, merge, new, pull, validate, secrets, settings, migrate, charly-mcp-cmd.

plugins.name: charly-cache
plugins.description: The `charly cache` git-ref cache operator surface — status, clear, refresh, bypass.

plugins.name: charly-candy
plugins.description: The `charly candy` authoring surface served by candy/plugin-candy.

plugins.name: charly-cardwire
plugins.description: The `charly cardwire` surface served by candy/plugin-cardwire.

plugins.name: charly-check
plugins.description: Live-container evaluation and probe verbs — `charly check` orchestrator + per-protocol live probes (cdp, wl, wl-overlay, dbus, vnc, spice, libvirt, record).

plugins.name: charly-coder
plugins.description: Self-contained skills + MCP wiring for charly coder/dev images (arch-coder, debian-coder, fedora-coder, ubuntu-coder, charly-arch). Ships the charly MCP server (port 18765). Bundles language runtimes (golang, rust, nodejs).

plugins.name: charly-comfyui
plugins.description: Self-contained skills for running the comfyui image-generation/diffusion image.

plugins.name: charly-core
plugins.description: Runtime/lifecycle CLI verbs — start, stop, restart, charly-status, logs, shell, ssh, deploy, charly-update, remove, charly-config, cmd, charly-version, charly-doctor.

plugins.name: charly-crabbox
plugins.description: Self-contained skills for the crabbox image family: the Crabbox CLI (layer-crabbox), the local Node/PostgreSQL coordinator (pod-crabbox) and the `crabbox:` check verb (plugin-crabbox) — the fully-local remote-execution control plane.

plugins.name: charly-distros
plugins.description: Base OS images and hardware runtime — arch, fedora, debian, ubuntu, aurora, bazzite, GPU runtime (nvidia/cuda/rocm), bootc bootstrap, per-distro builders.

plugins.name: charly-feature
plugins.description: The `charly feature` / `charly box feature` Agent Driven Evaluation surface — run a deployment's baked plan as acceptance tests with agent grading.

plugins.name: charly-filebrowser
plugins.description: Self-contained skills for the filebrowser image (web-based file management on top of an charly volume).

plugins.name: charly-hermes
plugins.description: Self-contained skills for the hermes agent image (hermes + hermes-playwright variants). Consumes the jupyter MCP server for notebook manipulation — enable charly-jupyter alongside.

plugins.name: charly-image
plugins.description: Schema authoring reference for `kind: box` and `kind: candy` — charly.yml composition, task verbs, validation.

plugins.name: charly-immich
plugins.description: Self-contained skills for the immich photo-management image (immich + immich-ml variants).

plugins.name: charly-infrastructure
plugins.description: Infrastructure services and system layers — postgresql, redis, valkey, vectorchord, k3s cluster, traefik, supervisord, tailscale, gocryptfs, virtualization, dbus-layer, tmux-layer.

plugins.name: charly-internals
plugins.description: Development internals for charly contributors — Go source map, install-plan IR, capabilities/OCI labels, vm-spec, libvirt/cloud-init renderers, cutover-policy, strict-policy, disposable, ovmf, generate-source, skill maintenance, and the agents/workflows/teams guide. Ships five agents (root-cause-analyzer, layer-validator, testing-validator, check-bed-runner, deploy-verifier).

plugins.name: charly-jupyter
plugins.description: Self-contained skills + MCP wiring for the jupyter image family (jupyter, jupyter-ml, jupyter-ml-notebook, unsloth-studio). Ships the jupyter MCP server (port 8888).

plugins.name: charly-kubernetes
plugins.description: Schema authoring for `kind: kubernetes` — Kustomize manifests, cluster probes via the `kube:` check verb, and the helm words (`helm-release` install step + `helm:` check verb).

plugins.name: charly-languages
plugins.description: Programming language runtimes and package managers — python, python-ml, pixi (others like golang/rust/nodejs live in `charly-coder`).

plugins.name: charly-local
plugins.description: Schema authoring for `kind: local` — local templates, ssh-host targets, managed ssh-config fragment.

plugins.name: charly-ollama
plugins.description: Self-contained skills for running the ollama LLM-server image. Pair with charly-jupyter to expose Ollama models to Jupyter notebooks via the jupyter MCP.

plugins.name: charly-openclaw
plugins.description: Self-contained skills for the openclaw image family (CachyOS base): the headless openclaw gateway and the maximal non-browser openclaw-full.

plugins.name: charly-openwebui
plugins.description: Self-contained skills for the openwebui chat-frontend image. Consumes the jupyter MCP server (enable charly-jupyter alongside) for in-chat code execution.

plugins.name: charly-pipeline
plugins.description: The `charly pipeline` agent/workflow engine — plan agent stage, plan executor, deterministic probe verbs, template/frontmatter rendering.

plugins.name: charly-pod
plugins.description: Schema authoring for `kind: pod` and `kind: deploy` — charly.yml shapes, nested deploys, sidecars.

plugins.name: charly-pod-verbs
plugins.description: Pod-lifecycle CLI verbs served by candy/plugin-pod — cp (host<->container copy), volume (list/reset named volumes), restart.

plugins.name: charly-punktfunk
plugins.description: Self-contained skills for the punktfunk streaming-host image family (CachyOS base): the punktfunk/1 QUIC host daemon, its browser console and its plugin runner, installed from unom's signed pacman repo with a headless Sway compositor for the host to drive.

plugins.name: charly-review
plugins.description: The `charly review` read-only GitHub PR review engine — verb:pr tools, the chat-completions review loop, verdict emission.

plugins.name: charly-selkies
plugins.description: Self-contained skills + MCP wiring for the selkies-desktop family (Wayland desktop in a container with VNC + Chrome). Ships the chrome-devtools MCP server (port 9224).

plugins.name: charly-tools
plugins.description: CLI utilities and the charly binary deploy artifacts — ripgrep, himalaya, whisper, nano-pdf, summarize, ordercli, gogcli, sherpa-onnx, plus the `charly` binary deployment skill.

plugins.name: charly-versa
plugins.description: Self-contained skills + MCP wiring for the versa image — a marimo notebook environment (marimo + Airflow + OSM/GTFS analytics + martin vector tiles + five PMTiles generation pipelines: tippecanoe / gpq-tiles / DuckDB ST_AsMVT / DuckDB → freestiler / Shortbread-via-Tilemaker, plus PMTiles Viewer SPA on port 28001 + VersaTiles Frontend on port 28002 + versatiles serve as second tile server on port 28090). Ships marimo (port 22718) and airflow (port 29999) MCP servers.

plugins.name: charly-vm
plugins.description: Schema authoring reference for `kind: vm` + bootc VM catalog — libvirt/QEMU backends, cloud_image vs bootc sources.
